variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by a union in the colony.
variants.body:
A union has called a strike in {colony}. The call establishes a labour action, not an account of its participation or outcome. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the decision to call a strike from unreported claims about wages, conditions or the response of an employer.

We support {target} in this assessment. A call for collective action deserves a fair account, and the existence of conflict does not establish that every accusation against a participant is justified.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.sub: The colony has a union call for strike action.
variants.body:
Withholding labour is now the subject of a union's strike call. The event places the relationship between work and bargaining in public view. For {target}, responsibility should be judged without supplying a demand, a workplace closure or an agreement that this report does not establish.

We support {target} in this assessment. A call for collective action deserves a fair account, and the existence of conflict does not establish that every accusation against a participant is justified.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.sub: A union has called a strike in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony has a call for strike action by a union. That is the known development; the course of the dispute is not specified here. An assessment of {target} should examine the politics of labour action without fabricating a turnout, a legal finding or a settlement.

We support {target} in this assessment. A call for collective action deserves a fair account, and the existence of conflict does not establish that every accusation against a participant is justified.
